name: CWC Chicago Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top singles title, contested in an eight-man single-elimination tournament at the fed's first pay-per-view and won there by Andrew "Flash" Tucker, who beat Jack Vars in the final by submission after outside interference from Outcast by Society.

name: CWC Cook County Championship
epitaph: The fed's own secondary singles title, contested in an eight-man single-elimination tournament at the fed's first pay-per-view; the final was a ladder match, won there by "Flatlander" Duke Putrid over Tommy Grayson.

name: CWC Skyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own cruiserweight title, a 225-pound weight limit, named in its own player's guide but never contested in any document this collection holds.

name: CWC Chicago Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own tag team championship, named in its own player's guide but never contested in any document this collection holds.
